purpose: Exploratory validation-only matched class-weight comparison; not clinical early prediction or confirmatory testing
selection: First maximum validation macro_f1 rounded to six decimals over the complete fixed budget; no early stopping
class_weights: Use shared class_weights on full training labels only: sqrt(N/(30*n_c)); no validation weighting and no resampling
reuse_policy: Verify completed manifests, source snapshots, selection policy, cohort/label order, original checkpoint replay provenance, and recomputed selected metrics. Do not resume historical models under changed live sources. No neural retraining authorized.
ensemble_policy: Equal probability average across exactly three independently trained seeds, each selected with the same primary metric; separate rows from single-model mean and sample SD

uncertainty.method: Paired stratified-by-true-class patient bootstrap, same sampled patients for compared models
uncertainty.scope: Conditional on the fixed validation cohort, selected checkpoints and class supports; does not account for model selection or training uncertainty; class intervals are pointwise, not multiplicity corrected

rare_class_policy: Lowest training-support quartile: floor(30/4)=7 classes, stable class-index ties; existing validation-support <=100 grouping retained only as explicitly exploratory historical comparison
compute_fairness: Matched information, folds, weights, metric and seeds, NOT equal architecture, optimizer, compute budget or checkpoint-search count (30 GCHM epochs versus 1200 boosting rounds)
clinical_limitations: Native temporal_clean=false. History may include current/future diagnoses; whole-visit labs and stay-wide vitals are not availability-safe. External time-aware evaluation and clinical cost analysis remain required.
